title: Build error when building for Android with mesh_instance_2d and clipper.core
body:
### Tested versions


    Reproducible in: 4.4-stable, 4.3-stable
    Not reproducible in 4.2.1

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot 4.4.stable - Vulkan (Compatible) - intel iris

### Issue description


Godot doesn't compile with scons given the following terminal log for a 2D release:
```
ERROR: In file included from scene\2d\mesh_instance_2d.cpp:38:
.\thirdparty/clipper2/include/clipper2/clipper.h:17:10: fatal error: 'clipper2/clipper.core.h' file not found
#include "clipper2/clipper.core.h"
         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
1 error generated.
 
scons: *** [scene\2d\mesh_instance_2d.android.template_release.arm32.o] Error 1
ERROR: In file included from scene\2d\multimesh_instance_2d.cpp:38:
.\thirdparty/clipper2/include/clipper2/clipper.h:17:10: fatal error: 'clipper2/clipper.core.h' file not found
#include "clipper2/clipper.core.h"
         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
1 error generated.
 
scons: *** [scene\2d\multimesh_instance_2d.android.template_release.arm32.o] Error 1
scons: building terminated because of errors.
INFO: Time elapsed: 00:07:18.49 
```


### Steps to reproduce

1. Download Godot source code and required build tools
2. Compile the engine with command: 

`
scons platform=android arch=arm32 optimize=speed lto=full target=template_release production=yes debug_symbols=no separate_debug_symbols=no module_squish_enabled=no builtin_squish=no progress=no warnings=no disable_3d=yes module_bullet_enabled=no module_raycast_enabled=no module_mobile_vr_enabled=no module_openxr_enabled=no module_text_server_fb_enabled=yes module_text_server_adv_enabled=no module_ktx_enabled=no module_basis_universal_enabled=no module_meshoptimizer_enabled=no module_tinyexr_enabled=no module_vhacd_enabled=no module_webxr_enabled=no minizip=no deprecated=no module_bmp_enabled=no module_svg_enabled=no module_tga_enabled=no module_theora_enabled=no module_noise_enabled=no module_das_enabled=no module_etc_enabled=no module_hr_enabled=no module_pvr_enabled=no module_recast_enabled=no module_thekla_unwrap_enabled=no module_camera_enabled=no module_gridmap_enabled=no module_hdr_enabled=no no_editor_splash=no builtin_recastnavigation=no builtin_rvo2_3d=no builtin_libtheora=no builtin_openxr=no module_csg_enabled=no module_zip_enabled=no builtin_zlib=no graphite=no builtin_graphite=no builtin_icu4c=no builtin_clipper2=no builtin_xatlas=no module_xatlas_unwrap_enabled=no module_dds_enabled=no module_regex_enabled=no module_multiplayer_enabled=no module_jsonrpc_enabled=no module_enet_enabled=no builtin_enet=no module_webrtc_enabled=no module_websocket_enabled=no builtin_wslay=no builtin_embree=no use_mingw=yes 
`

Exclusive to 4.4:
swappy=no
